first_last_frame.notes: Official local template interpolates between start/end frames.

native_audio.notes: Separate video/audio VAEs generate synchronized audiovisual output.

native_multi_shot.notes: Native multi-shot is a core LTX-2.5 capability.

automatic_duration.notes: Duration-head and caption-driven auto-duration supported by 2.5 pipelines.

prompt_enhancer.notes: Gemma 4 E2B prompt enhancer is available in official templates.

ic_lora.notes: Advanced local workflows support IC-LoRA control and reference conditioning.

reference_video.notes: Use a verified IC-LoRA/local workflow; not a generic zero-config reference input.

reference_image.notes: Additional reference/keyframe control requires an appropriate local workflow; standard I2V consumes first frame.

reference_audio.notes: Advanced A2V/A2A/AV conditioning is workflow-dependent; verify the configured local pipeline.

video_extension.notes: Prefix/suffix conditioning is supported in flexible/trained local workflows, but is not a standard LTX-2.5 cloud endpoint.

inpainting_outpainting.notes: Official advanced IC-LoRA workflows exist; adapter/checkpoint compatibility must be verified for LTX-2.5.

notes: Local limits depend on checkpoint, workflow, VRAM and pipeline configuration.
Official docs recommend ComfyUI or native ltx-pipelines for automation.

knownRisks: Do not assume every LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA adapter is validated on 2.5; check adapter documentation.
Generic reference assets require a known local workflow rather than automatic raw injection.
Local resource requirements are substantial and should be preflighted by Worker/ComfyUI.

notes: Local pipelines can use explicit frames/FPS or auto-duration depending on checkpoint/workflow.
Use chronological prose with explicit cuts and continuity language.
Only enable when the configured local prefix/suffix/extension workflow has been explicitly verified.
